questions.stem: Why does aerobic respiration release more energy per glucose molecule than anaerobic respiration?

options.text: Because anaerobic respiration uses more glucose
Because aerobic respiration completely breaks down glucose using oxygen
Because aerobic respiration does not produce any waste products

questions.explanation: Aerobic respiration completely breaks down glucose using oxygen, releasing all the stored energy. Anaerobic respiration only partially breaks down glucose, so the products (lactic acid or ethanol) still contain chemical energy that has not been released.
